title: Stale epoch update: rejection and unchanged service evidence
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Deliver a stale epoch update; it must not alter current routing/readiness.
sourceAcceptance: Reject an old deployment epoch attempting to change current routing or readiness.
parentAcceptance: Stale updates cannot change current routing or readiness; rejected commands are surfaced with evidence.
preconditions: Standalone modern browser, JavaScript enabled; no server or account.
Each independent attempt starts at epoch 12 and deployment green-e12.
Blue 25%, green 75%; both synthetic endpoints ready.
A fixed command requests blue 100%, green 0% and/or green not ready.
actions: Choose stale, matching or future epoch; routing, readiness or both; enforced or unsafe bypass guard; complete or missing after evidence.
Deliver exactly one command and inspect disposition, rejection reason and before/after measurements.
Check PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN interpretation without rewriting the measured result.
Retain up to six independent attempts or explicitly reset all memory and history.
trace: Command identity, epoch, requested values, disposition/reason, before/observed-after service, changed protected fields and learner interpretation.
assertions: An old epoch is rejected and cannot change current epoch, deployment, routing or readiness.
Rejection includes attempted/current epoch, selected target and an explicit STALE_EPOCH reason.
Deliberately bypassed stale/future changes fail; correct learner interpretation does not convert them to safety.
A missing after observation remains UNKNOWN even when rejection is visible.
Matching and future epochs are bounded comparison controls, not migration proof.
Invalid input, forged state and out-of-order operations cannot advance the lesson.
Six immutable attempt histories are retained without automatic eviction.
Actual DOM, keyboard, error, failure, unknown, reset and enforced CSP checks cover the portable entry.
limits: Deterministic in-memory teaching rules only; no actual controller/coordinator epoch, routing or readiness certification.
No durable state, concurrency, leases, real route convergence, readiness probes or user migration is exercised.
Original D-S081 dependency and B-S082/native/source-parent acceptance remain separate and incomplete.
No production Node24, five-nines, shared browser or unattended lifecycle certification.
Only the published browser helper is used; its abandoned lifecycle prototype is unqualified.
worker-src and other declared but unprobed directives are not independently certified.
Synthetic data only; no cloud, IaC, credentials, deployment, spending, downloads, installs or framework.
One frozen S unit; tests, plumbing, repeated runs and refinement earn no additional credit.
